channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump says US will not strike Iran before midterm elections
item.description: Oil prices drop as Trump dismisses speculation of pre-midterm military action against Iran.

item.title: How October 7 changed Lebanon and Hezbollah’s political reality
item.description: Analysts say Hezbollah's decision on October 8 to join a 'war of support' for Gaza changed Lebanon's political reality.

item.title: Mexico prison clash in strife-torn Sinaloa state leaves 10 dead
item.description: Nine inmates and one visitor killed in Sinaloa prison riot, local authorities say.

item.title: USS Lincoln returns to US after long deployment supporting war on Iran
item.description: Crew members express relief after a record 265 days at sea that strained conditions on board.

item.title: A father’s agony after an Israeli air strike hits Gaza apartment
item.description: An Israeli air strike hit a building in Gaza City’s al-Sabra neighbourhood, killing several people, including children.

item.title: Iran war live: 3 Saudi citizens killed in attacks on Riyadh airport
item.description: Civil Aviation Authority says King Khalid International Airport subjected to two attacks on Thursday.

item.title: Tanker hit by multiple projectiles in Gulf off Qatar, maritime agency says
item.description: Casualties have been reported on the vessel, identified by a maritime intelligence firm as the oil and chemical tanker, Acers.

item.title: Most UK diplomats to leave East Jerusalem consulate, Israel says, as Miliband says 'vital services' to remain
item.description: Israel said in September it would act in response to UK sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank.

item.title: 'Every day there is killing': Palestinians in Gaza face Israeli strikes despite ceasefire as peace deal stalls
item.description: Many Palestinians are still living in cramped tent cities, with the US plan to end the war largely stalled.

item.title: ​​USS Lincoln finally docks in San Diego after 10-month mission
item.description: The US aircraft carrier was set to return in May but the war with Iran has kept it at sea on one of the longest deployments ever.
